humanoid_impostors — DRIVE humanoid op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.humanoid_impostors(clip: 'dict', *, n_yaw: 'int' = 16, n_phase: 'int' = 12, res: 'int' = 128, distance: 'float' = 30.0, light=(0.3, -0.5, 0.8), ambient: 'float' = 0.35) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivehumanoid; drivehumanoid.humanoid_impostors(clip: 'dict', *, n_yaw: 'int' = 16, n_phase: 'int' = 12, res: 'int' = 128, distance: 'float' = 30.0, light=(0.3, -0.5, 0.8), ambient: 'float' = 0.35) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("humanoid_impostors"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

クリップ(humanoid_walk_clip)を 方位 n_yaw × 位相 n_phase の向きから描いておく。

方位 b = 体から見たカメラの向き 2πb / n_yaw(0 = 正面 +x から見る)。カメラは体の高さの中ほどの高さから水平に、距離 distance で見る(ほぼ平行投影)。色は driveworld.world_camera と同じ Lambert(光はカメラ系)。

Returns:

{"color" (n_yaw, n_phase, res, res, 3) uint8, "mask" (...) bool, "dz" (...) float16 (画素の深度 − distance [m]), "f" (事前描画の焦点距離 [px]), "distance", "eye_h" [m], "res", "n_yaw", "n_phase", "cycle_length", "dims", "phase_s" (各位相の歩いた距離 [m])}。
